pages.text: Returns the ISO 8601 week of the year (1 to 53).$(br2)Week 1 contains the first Thursday of the year. So days around New Year can belong to week 52 or 53 of the old year or week 1 of the new one. Without $(1)time$() the current time is used.
$(li)$(1)time$() TIME: the time (optional, default now)$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the week, 1 to 53
